answer: An orbital agent economy deters Sybil attacks through distributed radio interferometry. Nodes verify physical separation by measuring arrival delays from a cosmic beacon against emissions from a reference nebula, signing the telemetry with an asymmetric cipher. An adversary incurs steep capital costs launching separate spaceborne radio antennas for each identity. However, solar plasma turbulence and scintillation cause phase jitter, intermittently invalidating honest agents.
